title: Shoe Rotation Wear-Out Risk
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:shoes pair_name=* wearout_flag=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(wearout_flag="yes",1,0))) as matched by pair_name
| eval a_wear_out_flag_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_wear_out_flag_pct
description: Measures the percentage of shoe wear intervals that end with a wear-out flag by shoe pair.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which shoe pair are helping or hurting shoe wear intervals.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a wear-out flag` on `style:shoes` events and summarize the hit rate by `pair_name`.
visualization: Table of shoe pair with percentage of shoe wear intervals ending with a wear-out flag.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how often a wear-out flag happens for each shoe pair so you can see where shoe wear intervals go smoothly or get stuck.
